minimum_rationale: The learned projection is the smallest architectural addition that consistently clears the recovery and likelihood gates.
Removing all explicit anti-collapse terms did not collapse the projected model in either the K=28 main study or K=64 overcomplete stress test.

The pooled-model study found the 50/50 fragment/loss decoder important for this model family. The later ETM-specific channel-balance screen should not be interpreted as invalidating that pooled-model result.
transfer_rationale: The weak mutual-information term adds no parameters and only one scalar loss term.
It was nearly neutral on the main corpus and modestly improved motif recovery and theta recovery in the K=64 stress test.
Because K=64 is still far below K=1000, the real-data pilot should run lambda=0 and lambda=0.05 side by side rather than treating anti-collapse as settled.
